text: Reviewer check: compare the PR file list (gh pr view --json files) with what the description and index.html reference; a new activity JS file can be left untracked and missing from the commit.
Reviewer check: Developer PRs can be stacked on unmerged sibling feature branches, so the diff against main includes other activities' files; note the merge order in the review.
Reviewer check: activity buttons wired only to pointerdown with preventDefault() are not keyboard-activatable (Enter/Space fire click); note as a minor non-blocking suggestion.
Reviewer check: gh pr checkout can leave a stale detached HEAD from another branch; verify with `git fetch origin <branch>` and read files via `git show FETCH_HEAD:<path>`.

Reviewer check: for spring/physics-based motion, re-simulate the update step in Node (redirect mid-flight, landing time) to verify AC claims about continuity and duration instead of trusting the PR description.

Reviewer check: when a PR is re-labelled ready-for-review with an unchanged head sha, compare it with the previously reviewed sha first; if unchanged, post a short re-confirmation rather than a full re-review, and don't implement human-requested fixes yourself.

Reviewer check: in child-page akwarium.js the wall-avoidance margin must scale with turn radius (speed/turnRate), otherwise fish pin against walls on wide screens; margin ≈ 0.16·width is safe against overlap.
Reviewer check: when a child-page SVG overlay looks like a 'smaller separate shape', suspect the global `.stage svg` 120px rule and verify the overlay selector is scoped `.stage .<class>`.

Reviewer check: child-page playtime.js re-reads state from localStorage every tick (refresh/load), so when storage throws the in-memory 'used' is discarded and the limit is never enforced; check storage-unavailable fallbacks in any reload-from-storage state code.

Reviewer check: child-page PRs whose issue mandates manual browser testing the agent cannot do are accepted by code reading with no label and a human ask for recorded results (precedent: PRs #20, #23).

Reviewer check: child-page Playtime.start() calls stop(), which cancels any running fade and resets stage opacity; any animation started by renderLater before start() in app.js render() is wiped, so check call order when adding state to stop().

Reviewer check: when a fix reorders calls to avoid a cancel/reset side effect (e.g. start() before renderLater()), re-trace the whole flow including later timer ticks and guard flags (shownLater, fading) to confirm the fade is never repainted at full opacity.

Reviewer check: when a human reports a visual glitch on an animated flow, re-trace the first tick that reaches the end state (e.g. paint() at progress >= 1 before onExpire) for side effects that reset the animated property.

Reviewer check: child-page pooled-DOM activities (deszczyk.js) cap live elements by skipping spawn when the pool is full; verify the cap math (clouds × rate × fall time) and that all timing runs in one capped-dt rAF loop that stops when idle.

Reviewer check: for Hermite/spring stop-planning code (child-page pociag.js), verify monotonicity by simulating random start speeds and distances in Node; a cubic Hermite with end speed 0 is monotone when v0*T <= 3D, and the code's v*T > 2D guard adds a lap.

Reviewer check: for pooled-DOM child-page activities, run the mount function in Node with a stub DOM (fake rAF, createElement, pointer events) under a ~30 taps/s storm to confirm the node count stays bounded and cleanup leaves the scene empty.

Reviewer: cloning the repo is blocked in the sandbox; review via `gh pr diff`, `gh pr view --json files,comments` and `gh api repos/<o>/<r>/contents/<path>?ref=<sha> -q .content | base64 -d > /tmp/x.js` then `node --check`.

Reviewer: for merge-only re-reviews of child-page stacked PRs, use `gh api repos/<o>/<r>/compare/<old>...<new> -q '.files[].filename'` to confirm the activity's own js file is untouched, then check conflict markers (grep) and `node --check` on fetched files.

Reviewer: for README/docs PRs on child-page, verify activity names and order against js/activities.js on main (issue text may list a different order), confirm in-page anchors exist, and spot-check descriptions against the activity js files.

Reviewer: on child-page activity PRs, check `gh pr view --json commits,files` for foreign activity files (sibling branches stacked on a PR but targeting main); an unrelated activity commit is a blocking scope-creep finding and also skews the README activity count.

Reviewer: on child-page new-activity PRs, check the position of the new entry in js/activities.js (must be appended at the end, after the last existing activity); developers sometimes insert it mid-list, which fails the 'end of Settings list' criterion and makes README order disagree with the menu.

Reviewer: on child-page activities, a 'min 56px' floor on a base unit U does not guarantee 56px blocks when shapes are fractions of U (e.g. 0.8*U); compute the smallest block dimension at the U floor and in common phone-landscape sizes.

Reviewer: on child-page activity PRs, check the arrows/letters/pictures min sizes in CSS (e.g. nav 60px, picture clamp floor 96px) and that no storage/audio calls exist via grep on the activity js, alongside the usual position/README-count checks.

Reviewer: before accepting a child-page activity PR, grep its CSS block and root class against ALL existing prefixes in css/style.css; a reused prefix (e.g. Cienie reusing Co nie Pasuje's cn-) lets a later rule such as .cn-glow{opacity:0} silently break an already merged activity, even when the new activity looks fine alone.

Reviewer: `gh pr checkout <n>` can leave the clone on the previously checked-out branch; verify with `git status`, or use `git fetch origin <branch> && git checkout -B <branch> FETCH_HEAD` before reading the diff.

Reviewer: when `git diff origin/main...HEAD` unexpectedly shows a sibling activity's file (e.g. autobusik.js in a rakieta PR), the local origin/main is stale; run `git fetch origin main` and re-diff before flagging foreign commits.

Reviewer: when checking 56px targets on child-page activities, check button HEIGHT as well as width; sprites with aspect ratio != 1 (e.g. ducks sized DS x 0.875*DS) fall below 56px on short landscape screens even when the width floor is 56.

Reviewer: when reviewing child-page CSS diffs, check edited existing selector lists (a removed `, .x:focus-visible` can be merged into a new rule's declarations), not just added rules; this once made the lawn stretch over the garden on keyboard focus.

Reviewer: for child-page random-content PRs, check the pick helper's call shape (Rand.pick(list, n)), that random.js loads before the activity script in index.html, and that hit/feed radius depends on f.size rather than the drawn outline, so new shapes need no hit-test change.

Reviewer: when child-page birds/flyers are laid out around the .dn-body sun/moon button in js/dzien-i-noc.js, check that the JS lane geometry (top 42%, size clamp(150, 38vmin, 320)) mirrors the CSS, otherwise birds can overlap the touch target.

Reviewer: for child-page shared-animal PRs (js/animals.js), node-eval Animals.pick and head(id,{shadow}) with a stub window plus random.js; verify ear/side extents (top/side fields) against each activity's viewBox scale, and that Farma-style pools are at least pick+4.
Reviewer: run `git fetch origin main` before diffing a PR branch; a stale origin/main makes a clean branch look stacked with other PRs' files (cross-check with `gh pr view --json files,commits`).

Reviewer: in child-page canvas activities that repaint a layer from an async Image (e.g. kapiel.js silhouette()), a cached image runs the callback synchronously inside frame(); the callback's start() plus the frame's own trailing rAF request create two concurrent loops (settles when idle, no lasting leak) — guard the trailing request with `if (busy && !raf)`. A quick Node stub with a manual rAF queue and a sync Image shows it.

Reviewer: for large docs-only PRs (e.g. 46 per-activity md files), verify with scripts — heading count per file, relative-link resolution, activity-id coverage vs js/activities.js — then spot-check a few docs against the source.

Reviewer: for child-page docs PRs, compare the branch with current main (`gh api repos/<o>/<r>/compare/<head>...main`) before accepting; docs written against an older main go stale when sibling PRs merge (e.g. #173 turned 'open, not on main' notes into wrong statements in ~17 per-activity docs), so also grep docs/ for '#<issue>', 'not on `main`' and '(open)' and verify each against merged state.
Reviewer: in child-page activity docs the numbered sections are '## N.' headings, so a section-count script must match '^#+ N\.' (a '^# N\.' pattern reports 0 for every file).

Reviewer: for child-page activities whose button wraps a sprite sized as height*aspect (e.g. dog race dw = dh*6/5), check BOTH button dimensions at the smallest lane/field height (landscape 568x320); width can fall below the 56px target even when height passes.

Reviewer: for new child-page activities, grep js/<name>.js for container.appendChild(root) — stub-DOM simulations cannot detect a root that is built but never attached, which leaves the activity blank in a real browser.

Reviewer: for new child-page activities that size an SVG via a CSS class (e.g. .kg-svg width/height 100%), check it against the global '.stage svg {120px}' rule (specificity 0,1,1); the class must be prefixed '.stage .<prefix>-svg' or the scene shrinks to 120px (also seen in bug batch #130).

Reviewer: a child-page 'ready-for-review' wake can arrive with ready-for-review already removed and no CI checks reported ('no checks reported' = no CI configured); that is not a pending state, so proceed with the review.

Reviewer: for child-page activity PRs, a quick pitfall checklist (appendChild(root), '.stage .<prefix>-svg' CSS prefix, unique prefix grep on main, activities.js entry last with count matching, docs section count) catches the recurring defects before the full read.

Reviewer: for new child-page activities with a top bar or list at the top-left, check it against the fixed 56px .back button (top/left 8px, z-index 10); content at left:12px sits under it and needs a ~72px left inset.

Reviewer: for looping canvas scenery in child-page, check every layer including small decorations (waves, flowers): loop length divided by that layer's pattern period must be a whole number, and alternating-height patterns (wv % 3) need an item count divisible by the cycle, otherwise the layer jumps at the loop wrap.

Reviewer: when re-reviewing a child-page fix for a looping layer, confirm the item count divides the height cycle and that offset/period gives an integer number of periods per loop (e.g. off=f*P with lam=P/6 gives 6).

Reviewer: for child-page dog-face changes, verify mouth/tongue by sampling the quadratic curves and tongue ellipse in node against the muzzle ellipse (centre hx+0.7*hr, ny; rx=snout, ry=0.5*hr); a normalised value <1 means inside, and the Jamnik (hr 11, snout 9) is the tightest breed.

Reviewer: when a docs/README PR merges main mid-review, recount every stated number against the table or list it describes (e.g. 'following 13 activities' vs 14 table rows); an earlier accept can go stale after the merge.

Reviewer: when re-reviewing a child-page docs PR after main moved, rebuild the 'who calls Analytics' set with `grep -l Analytics js/*.js` on a fresh main tarball (minus analytics/app/stats-ui) and compare it with the number of activities named in each table and with any number written in prose; hard-coded counts in prose are the usual stale spot.

Reviewer: when a child-page activity starts calling Analytics, two tables need a row: docs/activities/README.md analytics status AND the main README 'Usage statistics' table (plus its 'all other activities use automatic tracking only' sentence); PRs often update only one.

child-page Zakupy (js/zakupy.js): checkout() passes list ids to counterKinds(), which maps p.id again, so top-up kinds are undefined and byId() falls back to the apple (bug on main; fix: need = list.slice()).

Reviewer: for child-page placeholder/stub docs PRs, verify each stub's issue link, planned id and CSS prefix against the linked issue bodies (`Module: js/<x>.js, activity id <x>`, `CSS prefix`) and check cross-references saying 'above'/'below' point the right way.

Reviewer: when a re-review follows a 'both analytics tables' finding, confirm the main README usage table row plus its 'all other activities' sentence and docs/activities/README.md analytics row are all present before accepting.

Reviewer: for child-page 'never the same X three times in a row' rules, check WHEN the history is written; if it is updated only when an item lands/arrives (e.g. wedkowanie.js arrive()), rapid taps put several items in flight before any is recorded and the ban never applies (30/400 triples in a stub run) — record on pick/latch instead.

Reviewer: a reusable Node stub harness for child-page activities (fake setTimeout, manual rAF queue, El with classList/querySelector by class, innerHTML parsed into class-named children, Analytics event log, Rand stub) lets you simulate rounds, finale timers, rapid taps and cleanup without a browser; supply createElementNS and per-canvas getContext stubs (isPointInPath, clip) for SVG/canvas activities.

Reviewer: `gh pr checkout <n>` can leave the clone on a stale local branch from an earlier review (the diff then shows the wrong PR); confirm with `git branch --show-current`, or `git fetch origin <head-ref>` and `git checkout -B <name> FETCH_HEAD`, before diffing.
